description: Look up the ticker for a company name or partial symbol — 'Apple', 'TSMC', '2330', 'samsung', 'LVMH'. Use this first when the user names a company rather than a ticker, and check the market of the hit: a local subsidiary or a namesake in another country can share the name. Pass market (US, JP, TW, KR, FR, BE, DK, NZC) to search one market only. Results with market NZC are New Zealand registered charities, not listed companies.

market.description: Only this market: US, JP, TW, KR, FR, BE, DK or NZC
